name: Supported-slice P1 defects
why: The slice gate targets zero P0/P1 defects; the score excludes P0 and P1s filed today.

name: Wrong-way layer edges
why: Each forbidden layer import is to be removed.

name: Edges in folder cycles
why: Value-import cycles between folders are to be removed.

name: Offer parity divergences
why: The clients must offer the same engine actions.

name: Focus parity divergences
why: The clients must agree on focus and questions.

name: Closure-lint findings
why: Closed rows must have complete, valid evidence.

name: Compound kind uses
why: Generation names base kinds, not compound kinds.

name: Marks without witnesses
why: Every mark must have a witness.

name: Stranded authored content
why: Authored content should be reachable in a played world.

name: Lives missing the first dungeon
why: A wanderer should also reach the first dungeon in the first hour.

name: Moves without a worthwhile lead
why: No stretch should be blank of worthwhile leads.
